title: AO-MA-11E-2a GitHub Mirror Drift Report
description: Fail-closed read-only drift report from comparing GitHub mirror state (Milestone + Issues + Project) against the V5 projection manifest. Generated by ao_kernel._internal.ao_ma.github_mirror_drift.check_github_mirror_drift().

projection_manifest.description: Relative path to the projection manifest file used as expected state source.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA256 of the projection manifest at check time (state-at-check pin).

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the check ran.

network_allowed.description: Whether the CLI was invoked with --allow-network. False forces exit_decision=network_not_allowed.

token_env.description: Environment variable name resolved for GitHub token (NOT the value).

token_present.description: Whether the named env var was set (boolean only; token value MUST NEVER appear in report).

severity.description: All semantic drift is blocker (exit≠0); info severity is reserved for non-failing report metadata.

object_id.description: Identifier of the drifted object (issue number, label name, project number, anchor field name).

expected.description: Expected value from projection manifest (any JSON value).

actual.description: Actual value from GitHub API or parser (any JSON value).

exit_decision.description: Top-level decision driving CLI exit code: synced→0, drift→1, network/usage→2, api→3.

allOf.description: When exit_decision=synced, drift MUST be empty.
When exit_decision=mirror_drift_detected, drift MUST be non-empty.
When exit_decision=network_not_allowed, network_allowed MUST be false.
